1981-2415-4050-5931.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2738-3967-4556-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

620-1429-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

3257-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

1591-2459-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1591-2459-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

413-2946-4871-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2946-4871-6248.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

1661-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

924-4068-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4068-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three additional creatures.
You control at least one Mountain.
924-4068-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4068-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

5147-7084-7422.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

772-3175-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2178-5231-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

57-3094-4460-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-4460-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-5686.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-5686.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

573-5451-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-5451-5702-6763.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1020-2866-6518-6709.notablePrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1020-2866-6518-6709.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2534-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

2060-4186-4499-4929-6457.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional nonland permanent.
2060-4186-4499-4929-6457.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Felothar.
When Felothar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

56-443-2523-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-443-2523-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Magus of the Bridge and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-2523-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1637-2573-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1637-2573-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two other Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

1462-2929-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

618-1898.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Janjeet Sentry with haste.
When the Janjeet Sentry token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate the Janjeet Sentry token by tapping it and paying {E}{E}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1414-1649-2068-4404.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
1414-1649-2068-4404.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Goblin Engineer by paying {R}, tapping and sacrificing Corridor Monitor, targeting Lotus Petal.
Ashnod triggers, copying Goblin Engineer's ability, targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the first Goblin Engineer ability, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Goblin Engineer.
Resolve the second Goblin Engineer ability, returning Commander Sphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

505-2034-5003.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
505-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Izoni, adding {C}{C}.
When Izoni dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Izoni from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Izoni enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3129-3263.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3129-3263.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1707-2034-4776.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You have the highest life total.
1707-2034-4776.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Last Laugh, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

62-2011-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Savage Ventmaw do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Najeela and Savage Ventmaw.
62-2011-3263.description:
Declare Najeela and Savage Ventmaw as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding {6}.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-4681-4881.description:
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Activated Sleeper.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5003-5221.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sprouting Thrinax, adding {1}.
Sprouting Thrinax dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1479-2638-3147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2615-3587-4150.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
2615-3587-4150.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Shivan Meteor for {3}{R}{R}, dealing thirteen damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
